Rejects: no key delimiter, empty value, empty key. Repeated component names are allowed
Duplicate policy flag: record 4 is kept and flagged
Quoted comma in a name and in value r03 ('2,5'); record 3 spans two lines, so the reject of record 4 starts on file line 6
Separator ';'; values use a decimal comma
No header row: columns are named Col1, Col2, ...; LF line endings
No header: columns carried by their generated names
60 columns; only sample and r01..r18 are used
Supplier added aa_new before r01 and zz_new between r09 and r10. The mapping is stored by column name, so the output equals C08
A third delimiter level splits each component into name and revision; a component without '/' gets an empty revision

20,000 records; every 1000th has no key delimiter and is rejected, every 500th (not 1000th) has 3 components. Needs the ETLBox licence. Checked by count and SHA-1 of the lines 'sample_id,component,a,b,c' each ending in LF, in input order
Carry columns chosen by name; carried columns come first in the output
Default when the file has a header: carry every column that is not a value column or the source cell
Mapping is not a rule: slots of 2, 4, 1, 3, 3 and 4 columns; slot 4 skips columns (m09, m11, m13); m08, m10, m12 are unused; records have 1 to 6 components
Three lines before the header are skipped; record start lines count from the top of the file. Skipping lines in ETLBox is unverified
Transformed JSON, flat: one object per output row. Compare as parsed JSON, not as text
Transformed JSON, nested: one object per input record with a components array. rows_out counts the long rows
